column2: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

column1: # The NPDM declares 48 MiB of system resources. Startup requests a 6.20 GiB heap.
# The alias region holds the game's streaming allocator (main+0x7ed630): in Kokiri Forest it maps up to +4.5-4.75 GB of address regions (an 8 GB region, Mac runs v6c, spin1).
# With 2.38 GB (0x98000000) the allocator stops at +2.26 GB: the loader retries what does not fit, so the OptimizeChangeBanc thread (main+0xf7a0, a sead::Thread whose pass sleeps 16 ms
# only when all is loaded) spins a whole core (997 ms/s, process CPU 308% against 168%, same host, Mac run alias238; every iPhone run), and after 5-15 minutes outdoors
# VammManager::AllocateAddressRegion fails and the game aborts (the Mighty Green Kokiri Kid fork).
# 8 GB as in that fork (cheemu21/kid-with-sword-remake b783c0b7); main's reserve grows by the same 4 GB, so main's heap keeps its size. DM_ALIAS_SIZE overrides the region
# The game steps its time by a frame ratio, its base rate / its frame rate, whatever the frame took: frames longer than a vsync played in slow motion. The ratio takes the host's
# frame step instead (MATCH_FRAME_STEP in patches.py, found by its function on any build that keeps it): 1 vsync at 60 fps, 2 when 60 does not hold, so game time = real time
# Terrain height tiles are filled by the CPU in mixed CPU/GPU pools without an NVN flush.
# Experimental high-rate support; default stays 60. See the game note for validation limits.
